subject: maths
question: A cylindrical tube, open at both ends, is made of a metal sheet which is 0.5 cm thick. Its outer radius is 4 cm and length is 2 m. How much metal (in cm³) has been used in making the tube?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Volume of metal in a hollow cylinder = π × (R + r)(R − r) × h

Outer radius R = 4 cm, Inner radius r = 4 − 0.5 = 3.5 cm

Length h = 2 m = 200 cm

Volume = π × (4 + 3.5) × (4 − 3.5) × 200 = π × 7.5 × 0.5 × 200

Volume = π × 3.75 × 200 = 750π cm³

**∴ The correct answer is 750π cm³.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Outer radius (R) = 4 cm

Thickness of sheet = 0.5 cm

Length of tube (h) = 2 m = 200 cm

**Formula Used:**

Volume of metal = Volume of Outer Cylinder − Volume of Inner Cylinder = πR²h − πr²h

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e104fc4b64d80ecdd2cd7d14be6108d4959677f691909c808795ada9a6830a13.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Inner radius (r) = Outer radius − Thickness

⇒ r = 4 − 0.5 = 3.5 cm

⇒ Volume of metal = π × (R² − r²) × h

⇒ Volume = π × (4² − 3.5²) × 200

⇒ Volume = π × (16 − 12.25) × 200

⇒ Volume = π × 3.75 × 200

⇒ Volume = 750π cm³

**∴ The correct answer is 750π cm³.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Surface Area of Hollow Cylinder

Total Surface Area = 2π(R + r)(h + R − r), where R is outer radius and r is inner radius.

Curved Surface Area

CSA of hollow cylinder = 2πRh + 2πrh = 2πh(R + r).

Conversion Unit

Always ensure all units are consistent: 1 meter = 100 centimeters.</p
